blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in China on Wednesday ahead of a summit with his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping, and US President Donald Trump, who is on an Asian tour seeking diplomatic gains after a bruising election defeat at home. Trump was in the Philippines on Tuesday for a meeting with leaders of the so-called Quad countries.
